name: linux-studio-themes
description: Linux Studio's dark and light colour themes (matching the approved mockups) and a short welcome walkthrough. Data only, no code.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Linux Studio
walkthroughs.description: A private code editor that can only see your project folder.

steps.title: Your project folder
steps.description: Linux Studio can only see one folder, shown here as **project-folder**. Your home folder, other drives and system files are invisible to it. To change the folder, run `linux-studio --set-project-folder` in a terminal on your computer.

steps.title: Websites you approve
steps.description: Extensions and terminal tools can only reach websites you approve. A pop-up asks each time something new tries to connect. Open **Approved websites** from the Linux Studio menu entry to review the list.

steps.title: More languages
steps.description: Python, Node.js, C/C++ and Git are built in. Add other versions from official sources with **Toolchains** in the Linux Studio menu entry; every download is verified.

steps.title: Trusting a folder
steps.description: New folders open in Restricted Mode. Trust a folder you know to use the terminal, tasks and debugging. Linux Studio's sandbox protects you either way.
